contract: An active handle drag owns input and suppresses history; cancelled handle edits preserve their baseline.
reproduction: Load deterministic single-stroke fixture, lasso select it, open Transform.
Fill Move X with 30 and dispatch its change; input retains keyboard focus.
Mouse down on real scale handle at (636,412), move to (666,432), retaining capture.
Press Ctrl+Z during the captured handle drag.
expected: Move X remains 30 and native/application history is suppressed until handle completion or cancellation.
actual: Scale changes to 159.52324936200165, proving actual handle admission; Ctrl+Z leaves scale unchanged but Move X input becomes 0 instead of 30.
diagnosis: Native input Undo bypasses the document capture keydown guard because that guard omitted editDrag; SVG handle admission did not remove numeric-input focus, and the window shortcut handler ignores input targets.
builder_disposition: Application repair batch2 adds editDrag and touch ownership to input guards; original valid test retained unchanged. Retest required on CI3 integration identity.
